_comment: 1.12.2 和 1.20.1 不一样的翻译，以及 1.12.2 才有的键。值按原文写（单个 %），由 json2lang.py 统一转义。改完重新跑 python tools/lang/json2lang.py。

enchantment.carianstyle.beast_robust.des.en_us: All buff and debuff levels are doubled, but their durations are reduced by 60% (instant effects are unaffected).
enchantment.carianstyle.beast_robust.des.zh_cn: 所有增益和负面效果等级翻倍，但持续时间-60%（瞬间效果除外）

enchantment.carianstyle.beast_vitality.d.en_us: All buff and debuff durations +[Level] x 30%.
enchantment.carianstyle.beast_vitality.d.zh_cn: 所有增益和负面效果持续时间+[附魔等级]×30%

enchantment.carianstyle.lucidity.desc.en_us: Debuffs you receive are one level higher, but their durations are reduced by [Level] x 15% (levels add up across armor pieces).
enchantment.carianstyle.lucidity.desc.zh_cn: 受到的负面效果等级+1，但持续时间-[附魔等级]×15%（多件盔甲等级相加）
